    <meta name="description" content="An Optimizely DXP (Digital Experience Platform) Administrator manages and maintains the Optimizely DXP environment, including user access, deployments, and environment configurations. They utilize the Optimizely DXP dashboard and the Azure portal to monitor and manage the platform. The administrator also plays a crucial role in ensuring the smooth functioning of the DXP environment, including deployments, troubleshooting, and ensuring optimal performance.


Before taking your exam

Remember you will only have 14 days to complete the exam once purchased.
Please be advised that exams should be purchased solely by the individual planning to take them. Exam registrations are intended for individual use and cannot be transferred.
Complete Introduction to Optimizely DXP eLearning collection
Watch the  Optimizely DXP in 7 Minutes recording
Look closely at the DXP Cloud Hosting technical review
Familiarize yourself with how to monitor and troubleshoot with Application Insights
Get familiar with the Optimizely DXP Documentation
Understand common questions and solutions described in the Support Help Center


When you are ready to take your exam
You will have 75 minutes to complete 60 multiple choice questions. Failure to complete all questions on time will result in a failed assessment. Upon failing, you are required to wait 24 hours before you can retake the assessment. Failure to pass this assessment within 14 days will require you to purchase a new exam attempt. You need to score a minimum of 85% to pass the exam and become certified.

Once you pass your exam
You will receive an email notification for a Credly badge. You will retain your certified status for 24 months. If you do not see an email from Credly in your inbox, please check your other, junk, and spam folders.

Why become certified?

Gain industry-recognized credentials that validate your Optimizely expertise.
Enhance your professional credibility and career opportunities.
Demonstrate your ability to ensure secure, scalable operations of the DXP environment.
Stand out as a trusted administrator who can bridge teams and ensure the DXP is properly configured, deployed, and maintained.

An Optimizely DXP (Digital Experience Platform) Administrator manages and maintains the Optimizely DXP environment, including user access, deployments, and environment configurations. They utilize the Optimizely DXP dashboard and the Azure portal to monitor and manage the platform. The administrator also plays a crucial role in ensuring the smooth functioning of the DXP environment, including deployments, troubleshooting, and ensuring optimal performance.

Before taking your exam

*   Complete [Introduction to Optimizely DXP](/student/path/1271802-introduction-to-optimizely-dxpt) eLearning collection
*   Watch the [Optimizely DXP in 7 Minutes recording](/student/activity/1353631-optimizely-dxp-in-7-minutes)
*   Look closely at the [DXP Cloud Hosting technical review](/student/path/1271806-dxp-cloud-hosting-technical-review)
*   Familiarize yourself with [how to monitor and troubleshoot with Application Insights](/student/path/1271807-monitor-and-troubleshoot-with-application-insights)
*   Get familiar with the [Optimizely DXP Documentation](https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/digital-experience-platform/docs/dxp-overview)
*   Understand common questions and solutions described in the [Support Help Center](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us)

When you are ready to take your exam

You will have **75 minutes to complete 60 multiple choice questions**. Failure to complete all questions on time will result in a failed assessment. Upon failing, you are required to wait **24 hours** before you can retake the assessment. Failure to pass this assessment within **14 days** will require you to purchase a new exam attempt. You need to score a minimum of **85%** to pass the exam and become certified.

Once you pass your exam

You will receive an email notification for a **Credly badge**. You will retain your certified status for **24 months**. If you do not see an email from Credly in your inbox, please check your other, junk, and spam folders.

Why become certified?

1.  Gain industry-recognized credentials that validate your Optimizely expertise.
2.  Enhance your professional credibility and career opportunities.
3.  Demonstrate your ability to ensure secure, scalable operations of the DXP environment.
4.  Stand out as a trusted administrator who can bridge teams and ensure the DXP is properly configured, deployed, and maintained.
